title: Quire character manifest
description: The cast of one book, produced by the upfront scan (QUI-007) and consumed by attribution, casting and the character drawer. Unknown properties are preserved by readers rather than rejected, so a newer companion app can round-trip a manifest through an older TTS service without losing data.

id.description: Stable within a book. Duplicates are rejected: casting keys on it.

gender.description: An unrecognised value degrades to unknown rather than failing the load.

firstSeenLocator.description: Where they first speak, as chapter#p3#s1.

voice.description: ADR-0007: a voice is a stored description, not a speaker id. Every field is optional.

speakerId.description: Index into the TTS engine's speaker table.

espeakVoice.description: Stored as written, not validated against a list: resolvable identifiers are a property of the model file's bundled espeak-ng-data, not of this schema.

lengthScale.description: Synthesis rate, relative to the model's default.

description.description: Prose a human reads in the drawer and a model writes during the scan.

source.description: An unrecognised value degrades to auto rather than failing the load.
